items.name: Kyren Williams
items.text: Williams rushed 16 times for 80 yards and two touchdowns while catching 10 of 13 targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles.

items.name: Kyle Monangai
items.text: Coach Ben Johnson said after Sunday's 23-12 win against the Jets that Monangai suffered a thumb injury during the contest, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

items.name: D'Andre Swift
items.text: Swift rushed 15 times for 58 yards and caught both of his targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He also lost a fumble.

items.name: Tank Bigsby
items.text: Bigsby left Sunday's game against the Rams late in the fourth quarter with an apparent lower-body injury and went into the Eagles' tent on the sideline, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

items.name: Eli Raridon
items.text: Raridon (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Buffalo.

items.name: Mikel Brown
items.text: Brown (ankle) has progressed to taking some contact in practice and said Sunday that he's "starting to get to full speed," Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

items.name: Hunter Long
items.text: Long (knee) is questionable to return against the Giants on Sunday.

items.name: Reggie Gilliam
items.text: Gilliam (ankle) has returned to Sunday's game against the Bills, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: Braxton Berrios
items.text: Berrios (foot) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: Durham Smythe
items.text: Smythe (Achilles) won't return to Sunday's game against the Titans.

items.name: Antonio Williams
items.text: Williams caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

items.name: Stefon Diggs
items.text: Diggs caught five of nine targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

items.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
items.text: Croskey-Merritt carried the ball nine times for a season-low 15 yards and caught two of four targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

items.name: Jared Wiley
items.text: Wiley (coach's decision) is inactive against the Raiders on Sunday.

items.name: Garrett Nussmeier
items.text: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Raiders on Sunday.

items.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
items.text: Kaliakmanis completed 15 of 33 passes for 186 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts. He added 16 yards on three carries.

items.name: Jalen Milroe
items.text: Milroe (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Seahawks' emergency third quarterback against the Chargers on Sunday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.name: Jauan Jennings
items.text: Jennings is in line to see a boost in targets as the Vikings' No. 2 receiver for Sunday's Week 4 matchup against the Dolphins, due to Justin Jefferson (hamstring) being ruled inactive for the contest.

items.name: Jordan James
items.text: James (coach's decision) is inactive against Denver on Sunday.

items.name: Dallen Bentley
items.text: Bentley (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

items.name: Aidan O'Connell
items.text: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday.

items.name: DJ Uiagalelei
items.text: Uiagalelei (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game versus Seattle, though he is listed as the team's emergency quarterback.

items.name: Josh Downs
items.text: Downs caught three of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders.

items.name: Alexey Toropchenko
items.text: Toropchenko (upper body) will miss at least six weeks, the team announced Sunday.

items.name: Trey Lance
items.text: Lance (groin) is active for Sunday's game against Seattle.

items.name: Daniel Jones
items.text: Jones completed 19 of 34 passes for 143 yards and an interception in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders. He added two yards and a rushing touchdown on four carries while committing a fumble.

items.name: Mack Hollins
items.text: Hollins (calf) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.name: Ja'Marr Chase
items.text: Chase (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

items.name: Max Brosmer
items.text: Brosmer (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Vikings' emergency third quarterback against the Dolphins on Sunday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

items.name: Brady Cook
items.text: Cook (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Dolphins' emergency third quarterback against the Vikings on Sunday.

items.name: Tyler Warren
items.text: Warren caught all five of his targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders.

items.name: Jonathan Taylor
items.text: Taylor carried the ball 20 times for 95 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders. He also caught one of four targets for two yards.

items.name: Chris Brooks
items.text: Brooks is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 4 matchup against Tampa Bay due to an ankle injury, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: Jayden Daniels
items.text: Daniels (elbow) will be a full participant in practice for Week 5 prep with the aim to play against the Giants on Sunday, Oct. 11, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.name: Terry McLaurin
items.text: Head coach Dan Quinn said McLaurin (hamstring) "pushed to play" before being deemed inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts in London, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.name: Noah Penda
items.text: Penda (hamstring) participated in Sunday's practice and has been progressing in his ramp-up process, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

items.name: Ty Simpson
items.text: Simpson is inactive and serving as the Rams' emergency third quarterback Sunday versus the Eagles.

items.name: Anthony Black
items.text: Black (ankle) participated in Sunday's practice and has been progressing in his ramp-up process, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

items.name: Marcus Mariota
items.text: Mariota (knee), who was ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Colts in London, is set to undergo further tests after suffering an aggravation of the right MCL sprain he initially sustained in the Commanders' second preseason game, Molly McGrath reported on the NFL Network broadcast.

items.name: Behren Morton
items.text: Morton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Patriots' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

items.name: Michael Carter
items.text: Carter (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's tilt against the Ravens.

items.name: Ray Davis
items.text: Davis (hamstring) is expected to play against the Patriots on Sunday.

items.name: Marlin Klein
items.text: Klein (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.name: Colby Parkinson
items.text: Parkinson (shoulder/knee) is inactive for Sunday's Week 4 matchup against the Eagles.

items.name: Joe Fagnano
items.text: Fagnano (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Ravens' emergency third quarterback against the Titans on Sunday.
